tickets.title: Review and coordinate cash distribution request
tickets.text: Confirm the requested distribution amount, source account, destination, timing preference, tax withholding instructions, liquidity source, and any investment or retirement income impact before processing. Document client authorization and retain confirmation after the distribution is completed. The request is a $50,000 one-time transfer and an increase of Rowan's monthly IRA distribution from $4,000 to $5,000 to Teacup Comet Bank; the destination account needs verification because standing instructions show checking ending in 1184 while Rowan identified a newer household checking ending in 7729.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to confirm the source account, destination account, liquidity source, and withholding instructions before processing, with a date of 2026-02-18.

tickets.title: Coordinate account access recovery
tickets.text: Use this coordination template when Rowan Cloudpuddle cannot access the Velvet Acorn Custody portal after changing mobile carriers. Confirm identity requirements, preserve security, and document all handoffs without collecting passwords. The portal error prevents Rowan from retrieving recent confirmations and statements needed for distribution authorization.

subTasks.title: Confirm access problem and security boundaries
subTasks.text: Ask Rowan Cloudpuddle which portal is affected, what error message appears, whether multi-factor authentication changed, and what contact information is on file. Do not request or record passwords, full security answers, or authentication codes.

subTasks.title: Handoff to custodian or platform recovery channel
subTasks.text: Provide Rowan Cloudpuddle with the correct Velvet Acorn Custody recovery path, required identification steps, and support contact method. If advisor involvement is permitted, confirm what authorization is needed before joining a call or submitting a service request.

subTasks.title: Verify restoration and update records
subTasks.text: After Rowan Cloudpuddle reports access is restored, confirm whether contact information, trusted contact, delivery preferences, or document access settings changed. Update internal notes and flag any suspicious activity for further review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is portal access recovery, with a date of 2026-02-13.

tickets.title: Send care cost planning outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: Coordinate information needed to estimate care costs and funding options for Elena Mossbutton's possible assisted living.

Suggested message outline:

Hello [CONTACT_NAME],

I'm reaching out on behalf of Rowan Cloudpuddle to help organize the information needed for care cost planning. We are looking to understand the expected level of care, timing, available benefits, and likely monthly costs so the financial plan can reflect realistic assumptions.

Could you please provide or help identify the following?
- Current or anticipated care setting: [HOME_CARE/ASSISTED_LIVING/SKILLED_NURSING/OTHER]
- Estimated monthly care cost or rate sheet: [COST_DETAILS]
- Expected start timing or decision window: [TIMING]
- Insurance, long-term care policy, veterans benefits, Medicaid, or other benefits involved: [BENEFIT_DETAILS] (Elena's Silver Marmot Insurance long-term care policy has a $180 daily benefit, a 90-day elimination period, and an inflation rider)
- Key decision-makers or required authorizations: [CONTACTS]
- Documents needed from Apricot Compass Advisory or the client: [DOCUMENTS]

Please let us know the best way to coordinate next steps and whether any privacy authorization is required before you can discuss details.

Thank you,
[ADVISOR_NAME]
tickets.evidence: That evidence remains needed, with a date of 2026-02-27.

tickets.title: Run debt refinance review checklist
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before recommending a refinance for Rowan Cloudpuddle:

- Confirm current loan type, balance, interest rate, payment, remaining term, and prepayment penalties. (Pocket Lantern Bank HELOC: $38,000 balance, 8.1% variable rate; mortgage: $210,000 at 3.25%, $1,420 monthly P&I)
- Gather proposed refinance rate, term, payment, closing costs, points, and escrow changes.
- Calculate breakeven period using total refinance costs and monthly payment change.
- Compare total interest cost under current loan versus proposed loan if held through the expected time horizon.
- Check whether the refinance extends debt beyond retirement or another planning milestone.
- Review cash flow impact, emergency reserve impact, and debt-to-income considerations. (Rowan's stated minimum is nine months of basic living expenses in cash or very liquid reserves)
- Identify tax considerations, including mortgage interest deductibility assumptions where relevant.
- Confirm whether credit score, income documentation, appraisal, or title issues could affect approval.
- Note non-financial reasons for refinancing, such as payment stability, removing a borrower, or consolidating debt.
- Document recommendation, assumptions, and unresolved lender questions.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to assess whether paying down the line, refinancing, or leaving it in place is most consistent with the cash reserve target and retirement income plan, with a date of 2026-03-11.
